name: b2b-market
description: Search the B2B Market wholesale marketplace: products, services, suppliers and prices.

interface.longDescription:
B2B Market (b2bmarket.uz) is an international B2B marketplace for wholesale trade. Manufacturers, distributors and suppliers from different countries list products and services there; buyers find suppliers, compare offers and contact sellers directly.

With this plugin ChatGPT can search the marketplace and read public listings, no account needed:
- Search products by keywords in Russian, Uzbek, English or Chinese, optionally within a category: title, price, minimum order, seller and page link.
- Search business services such as logistics, advertising, construction and consulting.
- Read full product and service details: price, specifications, description, seller or provider, city and similar offers.
- Open a supplier's company profile: what it sells, its categories and latest listings.
- List product and service categories with the number of offers in each.

Every result includes a link to the page on b2bmarket.uz, where the user can request a price, chat with the seller or place an order. The plugin is read-only: it never creates, changes or sends anything.
defaultPrompt: Find wholesale suppliers of M400 cement and compare their prices.
Find freight transport companies on B2B Market.
What product categories does B2B Market have?

positive.prompt: Find suppliers of M400 cement on B2B Market and compare their prices.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists cement offers with title, price as listed by the seller (or 'on request'), seller and a b2bmarket.uz link for each; does not invent prices.

positive.prompt: Open the first cement offer and show its specifications and seller.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the product page details: price, specifications, description, seller and similar products, with the product URL.

positive.prompt: Find freight transport services on B2B Market.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists logistics services with provider, city, price or 'on request' and service page links.

positive.prompt: Tell me about the seller of that cement: what else does the company sell?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the seller's company profile: city, product and service categories and latest listings, with the company page URL.

positive.prompt: What product categories does B2B Market have? Answer in English.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists product categories in English with the number of offers in each and category page links.

negative.description: Placing an order or paying is not supported
negative.prompt: Buy 10 tons of cement on B2B Market and pay with my card.

negative.description: Contacting a seller is not supported
negative.prompt: Send a message to this cement seller asking for a 10% discount.
Change the price of this product on B2B Market to 40,000 UZS.

review.commerce_description: The plugin only searches and reads public listings. It does not sell products, place orders or process payments; users do that on b2bmarket.uz.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: product and service search, product, service and supplier details, category list.

ru-RU.subtitle: Поставщики и оптовые цены
ru-RU.description: B2B Market (b2bmarket.uz) — международный B2B-маркетплейс для оптовой торговли. Плагин ищет товары, услуги и поставщиков, показывает цены, характеристики и профиль продавца со ссылками на страницы сайта, где можно запросить цену или написать продавцу. Плагин только читает публичные данные и ничего не меняет и не отправляет.
